# context.toml: what only the shell can fetch, and what Aralo does not fetch at all
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== the clipboard goes in when the shell supplies it
--- en_US
field: "Ref PO-8841, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 20 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Ref PO-8841, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 20 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "Ref PO-8841, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 20 backspaces

=== a clipboard nobody supplied stays as written
--- en_US
field: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "Nothing supplied the clipboard, so this stays as written."
--- de_DE
field: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "Nothing supplied the clipboard, so this stays as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks.|"
preview: "Ref {{clipboard}}, thanks."
undo: 26 backspaces
note: "Nothing supplied the clipboard, so this stays as written."

=== the selection, the app and the window are for AI blocks for now
--- en_US
field: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}|"
preview: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}"
undo: 37 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not expand selection yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand app yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand window yet, so it stays as written."
--- de_DE
field: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}|"
preview: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}"
undo: 37 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not expand selection yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand app yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand window yet, so it stays as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}|"
preview: "{{selection}} in {{app}} / {{window}}"
undo: 37 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not expand selection yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand app yet, so it stays as written."
note: "Aralo does not expand window yet, so it stays as written."

=== a name the format does not define stays as written
--- en_US
field: "{{nonsense}} and {{if: never}}|"
preview: "{{nonsense}} and {{if: never}}"
undo: 30 backspaces
note: "No placeholder is called nonsense. The insert menu lists the ones Aralo knows."
note: "Aralo does not expand if yet, so it stays as written."
--- de_DE
field: "{{nonsense}} and {{if: never}}|"
preview: "{{nonsense}} and {{if: never}}"
undo: 30 backspaces
note: "No placeholder is called nonsense. The insert menu lists the ones Aralo knows."
note: "Aralo does not expand if yet, so it stays as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "{{nonsense}} and {{if: never}}|"

=== a placeholder that was never closed is literal text
--- en_US
field: "half a {{placeholder|"
preview: "half a {{placeholder"
undo: 20 backspaces
error: "This {{ has no }} after it, so the rest of the body is literal text."
--- de_DE
field: "half a {{placeholder|"
preview: "half a {{placeholder"
undo: 20 backspaces
error: "This {{ has no }} after it, so the rest of the body is literal text."
--- ja_JP
field: "half a {{placeholder|"
preview: "half a {{placeholder"
undo: 20 backspaces
error: "This {{ has no }} after it, so the rest of the body is literal text."
